shots.detail_en: HOOK: dawn fog on the old Lianhua hall rooftop; a black-suited figure stands with his back to camera at the exact spot of the ten-year-old fall — same composition as EP01 shot 1
Changhong pushes the rusted iron door open and walks step by step toward the back
shots.sub: 长虹：「熊天成。约我上天台——你不怕忌讳？」
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Xiong Tiancheng turns, white hair lifted by wind, smiling with mercy — his face dissolves for one instant into the young face from the 93 tape
shots.sub: 熊：「忌讳？长虹，这地方是我们两个人的起点。你的账，从这开始；我的，也是。」
shots.speaker: XIONG

shots.detail_en: He takes a gold-embossed file from his suit and spreads it on the rooftop railing
shots.sub: 熊：「联华要在港海市之外再开一间分所。操盘手的位置——我留给你。」
shots.speaker: XIONG

shots.detail_en: File header close-up: CHIEF ADVISOR — CANDIDATE PENDING
shots.sub: 长虹：「你在买我？」熊：「我在认亲。」
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Changhong stares at the file then slowly raises his eyes — and smiles exactly the way Xiong Tiancheng smiles: first same-frame same-smile
shots.sub: 长虹：「熊伯伯，你老了。十年前，你算我父亲用的是局；今天你算我，用的是话——因为你已经，做不动局了。」
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Xiong Tiancheng doesn't anger — he laughs aloud, flicking the prayer beads up his wrist
shots.sub: 熊：「像……真像。这句话的口气，比你的脸更像你父亲。」
shots.speaker: XIONG

shots.detail_en: EXPLOSIVE BEAT: the laugh cuts; he leans half a step closer, voice dropping
shots.sub: 熊：「想不想知道——93年6月17号，最后十分钟，你父亲在这个天台上，说了什么？」
shots.speaker: XIONG

shots.detail_en: Changhong's pupils contract; his clenched knuckles slowly loosen as he forces himself half a step back
shots.sub: 长虹（内心）：「他在骗我。可我不知道，他哪一句在骗。」
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Changhong turns and walks to the iron door, his back pausing one second at the threshold
shots.sub: 长虹：「等我把你从神坛上拆下来那天——你自己会说。跪着说。」
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Xiong Tiancheng left alone at the rooftop watching the leaving back — same composition as EP02's office photo scene
shots.sub: 熊：「陆振海……你儿子的恨，比你的人有意思多了。市场惩罚的是贪婪的人——可没有人说过，恨，算不算贪。」
shots.speaker: XIONG

shots.detail_en: Back in the war room, Changhong's first line on entering freezes the victory-day air
shots.sub: 长虹：「熊伟的算法、熊天成的电视、熊家的席位——三样都要拆。下一步，我需要更多的筹码。」
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Hongli's hand stops over the ledger, eyes lifting
shots.sub: 红利：「包括——不许亏的那一堆？」
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: Changhong silent two seconds, looking at the three characters PENSION FUND in the book
shots.sub: 长虹：「铁底我不破。但铁底上面的每一分钱——从今天起，全部进入战斗序列。」
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Mancang's grin stiffens bit by bit — the first time he doesn't fire back a joke
shots.sub: 满仓：「……包括我爹的盒子？」长虹：「包括。」
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Mancang sucks a breath, forces a grin, slaps Changhong's shoulder — the laugh uglier than crying
shots.sub: 满仓：「行！同盟嘛！长虹哥说打哪，咱就打哪——全仓！」
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Hongli watches Changhong's profile; slow dissolve: Changhong's silhouette overlaps Xiong Tiancheng's office silhouette from EP02
shots.sub: 红利（轻声自语）：「这个眼神……我在熊天成的眼睛里见过。」
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: Late night, alone in the war room, Changhong knots his tie to the tightest, facing his own reflection in the window glass
shots.sub: 长虹（对倒影）：「再像他一点——就能赢他。」
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: MIRROR-ABYSS FIRST FRAME: in the glass reflection, Changhong's eyes overlap for half a second with the smiling young Xiong Tiancheng from the 93 tape
CLIFF: from the rooftop across the street, Xiong Wei lowers his binoculars and closes the tracking tablet
shots.sub: 熊伟：「跟踪结束，样本归档。结论——爸把他带上天台了。爸，从没带我上去过。」
shots.speaker: XIONGWEI

shots.detail_en: Black screen act-opening next-episode card with white bold text
shots.sub: 字幕：「第三幕·真相与背叛——镜子里的人，是谁？」
shots.card: 第三幕·真相与背叛——镜子里的人，是谁？
